subject.title: [Feedback/Feature request] Please restore the ability to edit agent definition files (SOUL.md / AGENTS.md etc., persona files) directly from the Web UI

question: Does a clean v2026.7.1 Control UI session expose Agents → Files for a regular user, and if so is the current discoverability acceptable for remote deployments?
rationale: Current source and release notes retain the editor while the reporter describes a blocked shipped workflow, so a maintainer-controlled release-build check is needed to distinguish a runtime regression from an intentional navigation change.

options.title: Verify and repair the route
options.body: Reproduce the v2026.7.1 regular-user flow and fix the navigation, visibility, or packaged-assets path if Agents → Files is unavailable.

options.title: Improve discoverability only
options.body: If Agents → Files works, add a visible Workspace/Persona Files link or explanatory redirect from Config and update the user-facing documentation.

options.title: Confirm host-only policy
options.body: If browser editing was intentionally withdrawn despite the current source and release text, document that decision and provide an in-product migration or recovery path.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair the route
recommendation.body: Reproduce the v2026.7.1 regular-user flow and fix the navigation, visibility, or packaged-assets path if Agents → Files is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent signal is the v2026.7.1 Agents workspace integration and release provenance.
